Usage: provenance [OPTIONS] <COMMAND>

Commands:
  search           Find records across the permitted kinds in the bound scope, or the Rules bound to a source file and symbol.
  check            Check graph validity, statement quality, and binding coverage. Give a statement to check that text with the project dictionary before a write.
  prime            Introduce Provenance domain concepts and actions.
  init             
  materialize      
  export           
  import           
  validate         
  schema           
  dictionary       
  swarm-backtrace  
  skills           
  report           Deterministic report rendering from a versioned report envelope
  review           Serve local review assets and authorized repository operations
  mcp              Serve the MCP tools for one repository on standard input and output
  dogfood          Dev-build-only: record pain-point notes about provenance itself
  help             Print this message or the help of the given subcommand(s)

Options:
      --quiet    Drop the advisory notes commands print alongside their output, such as the warning that this repository has no shaping skills installed
  -h, --help     Print help
  -V, --version  Print version

Dynamic commands:
  provenance api [PATH]
  provenance api --filter <text>
  provenance <id> get --view children --depth <N>
  provenance <id> trace

Discussion actions: provenance discussions, or provenance <record-id> discussions|discuss, or provenance <discussion-id> discussion|reply.
